cards.definition: The query requests creating or updating an address-book contact entry or its fields.
includes: Add a contact, save an address as a contact, edit a contact field or register a contact as a favorite.
A clear creation/update request without all field values, including an explicitly directed conditional addition.
excludes: Retrieval alone, sending messages or placing calls alone, contact backup/export alone, and generic add-email wording whose contact-entry destination is not established.
Contact deletion is outside this creation/update definition; do not extend the operation family implicitly.
cards.coexistence: An additional lookup or message request does not cancel an independently expressed contact creation/update request.

cards.definition: The query requests retrieving, displaying, searching or verifying contact-channel/address information, or information explicitly from an address-book contact record or collection.
includes: Phone/pager numbers, email addresses, residential/postal addresses and associated dialing/area codes; checking a supplied contact detail is included.
Explicit contact record/list lookup, existence, count or attributes, even when the value has not been supplied or the person is referred to indirectly.
A separately requested lookup or contact-list check preceding addition, including a conditional workflow.
excludes: Sending or dialing alone, adding/editing alone, general personal facts without a contact-record source, communication history without an explicit contact-record source, and instructions about how to use the lookup feature alone.

Selecting a contact without a display/information request does not by itself request lookup. Ambiguous person/location/message references remain unavailable when they can reasonably denote a lookup target.
cards.stored_record_requirement: Explicit storage is required for arbitrary personal attributes, but not for a clearly requested contact-channel/address detail. The task does not assert the data is already stored or obtainable.
cards.coexistence: An additional creation/update or communication request does not veto this request when independently expressed.

supervision: Fresh reference proposals bound to this policy and these cards; old definition-fit labels remain historical and are not implicitly migrated.
scope: Full 147-source native contact cohort is a contrastive rule study, not a replacement for full 40513-recording training or a globally exhaustive semantic set.
